text:
rahul_sales: Heads-up 12mo enterprise commit conversation with NovaPay. They want cost-effective baseline + sustained hourly spikes at 800 RPS for 1hr, twice daily. Baseline is ~220 RPS. Also heavy rerank calls + embeddings (~90 RPS). Asking for recommended reserved config, autoscale guardrails, and what we can promise in SLA and security.

emily_se: clarifying q: are rerank + embeddings synchronous on the critical path? any batching on the client?

rahul_sales: yes, about 60% of chat requests call rerank (embedding similarity) inline. Client can batch embeddings up to 8 IDs but not reliably.

marcus_infra: summary of constraints we should plan for: concurrent tokens in flight, KV cache hit-rate, and rerank fan-out. If average response 120 tokens and rerank adds 40 tokens + 3 extra model calls for candidates, effective token work is ~240 tokens/request for those 60%.

emily_se: SLO ask from customer: P50 < 350ms, P95 < 900ms for conversational path. Theyre sensitive to tail latency.

marcus_infra: quick thumb-rule sizing I ran earlier (will bench properly): one H100 can handle ~90 RPS at 200 tokens p95 with model X, T4 ~25 RPS. But rerank flows change it. Proposal: hybrid reserved cluster: H100s for hot chat paths, T4s for background embedding indexing + low-priority inference.

marcus_infra: Proposed initial config (subject to perf validation):
```yaml
reserved_hot: 4 x H100 (chat + rerank primary)
reserved_warm: 6 x T4 (embedding service + lightweight rerank)
prewarmed_fast_pool: 3 x H100 (warm pool for spike absorption, <45s warm)
autoscale: max 10 H100-equivalents (mix of H100+spot H100)
kv_cache: intent_prefix_cache_enabled=true
batching: min_batch_timeout_ms=10, max_tokens_per_batch=8192
routing: route_by: [latency_sensitivity, model_size]
```

lena_ops: ops notes  AZ placement: split reserved_hot across 3 AZs (2/1/1) for resilience. Warm pool must be in same AZs to avoid cross-AZ cold start. Prewarm schedule: run `prewarm --pool fast --minutes 20` 10 minutes before business-hour peaks.

lena_ops: autoscale policy suggestion: scale on tokens_in_flight and queue_latency not only gpu_util. Example: scale_up when avg_queue_ms > 150 OR tokens_in_flight_per_gpu > 1e6, add one H100-equivalent every 20s, cooldown 3m.

ana_cs: security asks from NovaPay: BYOK for key wrapping, separate embedding retention policy per tenant, argument-level DLP redaction, and SOC2 + penetration test summary. Theyre regulated. Can we confirm Private deployment options?

marcus_infra: Private deployment: yes, we can do VPC + on-prem flavors; BYOK supported via customer KMS for Private and for Dedicated we offer a managed KMS integration. Embedding retention: we can configure retention window and purge endpoints. We also support request-level audit logs with searchable metadata.

rahul_sales: billing question: customer expects a blended effective token price after commit. They asked for examples if they do $150k/month. They want burst headroom without paying reserved for peak.

billing_bot: sample allocation model: 65% baseline -> reserved, 25% burst credits (preheat + short-run extra instances), 10% overage. For $150k: $97.5k baseline, $37.5k burst, $15k overage. Map baseline to GPUs: if 1 H100 month equivalent cost X, we need exact X to map. I'll run numbers when kevin provides perf.

emily_se: POC plan: 5-day sandbox with traffic replay (sanitized production trace) + 2 scheduled spike windows to simulate peak. Include AZ failover and chaos monkey for network loss. Need NDA and sanitized sample.

lena_ops: POC deliverables to include: runbook, SLA draft, telemetry dashboard access (token-level cost + latency by route), and simple rollback steps. Runbook snippets:
- preheat cron: `*/15 * * * * /rt-preheat --pool fast --minutes 30 --az all`
- autoscale snippet: `scale_policy: tokens_in_flight_threshold: 900k -> add 1 unit; cooldown: 180s`
- fallback order: [reserved_hot, prewarmed_fast_pool, spot_pool, degrade_model_variant]

marcus_infra: tradeoffs to call out in quote: quantization (q4f16) can reduce H100 pressure by ~1.6x but may slightly impact quality on small-context prompts. Recommend offering quantized variant as opt-in for cost-sensitive workloads. Also suggest per-route throttles for non-critical endpoints (embeddings) during spikes.

ana_cs: SLA language they requested: reserved capacity uptime (internal infra) 99.95% monthly for reserved_hot; credit schedule tiered by minutes downtime. We usually do 99.9 for Dedicated; 99.95 is a stretch - legal + infra signoff needed.

lena_ops: operationally 99.95 for reserved_hot is doable if they accept cross-AZ requirement + maintenance windows. Will need legal review.

rahul_sales: blockers list: 1) perf validation with NovaPay model trace 2) legal confirmation on 99.95 SLA 3) confirm BYOK region availability 4) pricing map to GPU-month equivalents for $150k commit.

emily_se: I'll coordinate NDA and request sanitized trace. Can we run an initial perf bench with their trace in the next 36h?

marcus_infra: I'll schedule perf runs on model variant tomorrow morning. Will measure RPS per GPU, tokens/sec, KV cache hit benefits, and cold-start times for prewarm pool. Aim to post results in this thread.

billing_bot: I'll draft two quote options by EOD tomorrow: conservative reserve (4H100+6T4) and performance reserve (6H100+8T4) with burst credits buckets.

rahul_sales: action items recap: 1) emily 1 NDA + trace request (today) 2) marcus 1 perf bench & numbers (tomorrow) 3) lena 1 SLA draft + runbook (tomorrow) 4) billing_bot 1 two quote variants (tomorrow EOD) 5) ana_cs 1 security pack + BYOK region check (today)

rahul_sales: thanks everyone  I'll update NovaPay after we have perf numbers. Ping me if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
